question: Where is the measured current-thread CPU cost of identical admit2_32 episodes spent, and does the run variation recur under one fixed policy?
hypothesis: Previous equal-workload repeated drift was largely in thread CPU, including native/driver calls; function profiling can localize cost without presuming a Python or CPU-placement cause.
event: Same two-old-token prefix and event after four outputs each. All three arms really submit the third request with the same event arrival rule; its waiting time is included in TTFT.
primary: full raw capture wall and current-thread CPU
exclusive profiled function CPU and primitive/total call counts
unchanged requests, steps, routing, cache transitions and actual payload
costs: Profiler wraps injection_episode including its setup/finally; raw capture time remains separate. dump_stats is after capture and retained in whole-process time. No subtraction or de-biasing. Thread CPU includes driver polling/spin and C functions; cumulative function times overlap.
prestate: Source-ID normalized logical metadata including output tokens, positions, KV counts and pager slots/LRU. Physical KV IDs retained separately; no KV tensor equality claim.
scope: Same OLMoE artificial expert-budget triplet and admit2_32 policy, six cells in one engine. Four instrumented episodes are source-localization diagnostics, not performance comparisons or estimates of a noise bound.
stops: Foreign GPU or failed query, source mismatch, missing requests, invalid admission/waiting/KV state, profile-scope failure or accounting mismatch aborts and retains the attempt.
comparison: All six structural traces and outputs; four full profiles with exclusive self CPU and call counts. Plain before/after provide context only. No policy ranking or controlled profiler-tax estimate.
continuation: If repeated CPU variation localizes to a specific path, change one evidenced factor in a fresh controlled comparison. If it does not recur, report that limit and retain all profiles; do not infer a causal origin or stable noise bound.
ordering: Six identical D episodes: plain, four CPU-profiled, plain. Diagnostic order; no randomization or independent blocks claimed.
action: All episodes set native max_num_running_reqs2 after the same common prestate; no release arm. Only middle four enable cProfile with time.thread_time around injection_episode; all warmups remain unprofiled.
required_costs: all profiling overhead retained in raw measurements
capture wrapper and dump scope metadata
